name: io.github.bnth09productions-maker/scrapling-x402-store-flows
title: Scrapling $1M+ Matched Orders, ETF Flows & Early BTC
description: $1M+ matched BTC/crypto order pairs, US spot ETF flows, treasuries & early wallets via x402.

tools.name: free_matched_orders
tools.description: FREE. Three recent pairings of a $1M+ sell/outflow with a similar-size buy/inflow (within 10%, 0-7 days) across US spot ETF issuer flows, SEC treasury filings, labeled Bitcoin exchange wallets and Hyperliquid fills. Each has a confidence score, match type (cross_entity or same_entity_round_trip) and the source of each leg. A match is a size-and-time pairing, not proof the same coins changed hands.

tools.name: free_etf_holdings
tools.description: FREE. Latest all-fund Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin ETF coin totals plus top funds from official issuer holdings. etf_holdings and etf_flows ($0.005) add each fund's bought/sold, shares, missing-fund notes, and related corporate holders (Strategy, Strive) labeled as companies, not ETFs. Returns JSON all-fund BTC, ETH, and LTC coin totals plus the top funds.

tools.name: free_crypto_treasuries
tools.description: FREE. Top 10 SEC-reporting companies by crypto treasury value (corporate bitcoin holdings, ETH/SOL treasury companies, miners) from SEC filings. crypto_treasuries ($0.005) adds every company, cost basis, filing links and per-asset totals. Returns JSON for the top 10 SEC-reporting companies by crypto treasury value.

tools.name: free_early_wallets_dashboard
tools.description: FREE. Latest confirmed moves from a watchlist of the largest early-era (2009-2012) Bitcoin wallets, with age, BTC and a current USD mark, plus watchlist totals. Covers the watchlist only, not every early coin. Returns status=first_sweep with no data until every watched wallet has been checked once. buy_dataset live_btc_early_era_wallets ($0.05) is the full file once live. Labels are estimates, never identity claims.

tools.name: free_country_btc_holdings
tools.description: FREE. Official, on-chain and court-record Bitcoin holdings for countries and governments, with as-of dates, sources, method badges and a CSV download. Human page at /countries. Not investment advice. Returns JSON country and government Bitcoin holdings with as-of dates, sources, and method badges.

tools.name: matched_orders
tools.description: PAID $0.08 USDC. Pairs each $1M+ sell or outflow with a similar-size buy or inflow from another entity (cross_entity) or the same entity (same_entity_round_trip) within 0-7 days. Sources: US spot ETF issuer holdings, SEC XBRL treasury filings, labeled Bitcoin exchange/custodian wallets (mempool.space) and Hyperliquid fills. Filters: asset, match_type, source_tier (all|institutional_only), min_usd, window_days, tolerance_pct, min_confidence, sort, limit. A match is a pairing, not proof of a counterparty.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: matched_orders_entity
tools.description: PAID $0.04 USDC. Every $1M+ matched buy/sell pairing involving one entity (for example IBIT, BINANCE, MSTR) plus its recent $1M+ legs. Unknown entity returns 404 with no charge.

entity.description: Entity id or ticker, e.g. IBIT, BINANCE, ARKB

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: etf_holdings
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Official issuer holdings for US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin ETFs (plus the Grayscale LTCN OTC trust, labeled as a trust not an ETF): ticker, product type, coins, shares, NAV, bought, sold, net change, AUM. Also all-fund totals, missing-fund notes, and related corporate holders (Strategy, Strive) clearly labeled as companies, not ETFs. Bought/sold is blank until two business days are saved. Filter asset=BTC|ETH|LTC or ticker. Returns JSON per fund (ticker, product type, coins, shares, NAV, bought, sold, net change, AUM) plus all-fund totals and missing-fund notes.

asset.description: Optional underlying asset. Format: BTC, ETH, or LTC, as the tool text states. Example: BTC. Omit for all three.

ticker.description: Optional comma-separated fund tickers. Format: uppercase tickers. Example: IBIT,ETHA,LTCC. Omit for every fund.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: etf_flows
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Day-over-day coin bought and sold for each US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin ETF from official issuer holdings snapshots. Blank until two business days are saved. Filter asset=BTC|ETH|LTC or ticker. Returns JSON day-over-day coins bought and sold for each matching US spot crypto ETF.

asset.description: Optional underlying asset. Format: BTC, ETH, or LTC, as the tool text states. Example: BTC. Omit for all three.

ticker.description: Optional comma-separated fund tickers. Format: uppercase tickers. Example: IBIT,ETHA,LTCC. Omit for every fund.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

tools.name: crypto_treasuries
tools.description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Every public company crypto reserve reported in SEC XBRL filings: company, ticker, CIK, asset, units held, fair value as filed, cost basis, as-of date, SEC filing link, live USD value (on-chain Chainlink price), totals per asset. Filters ticker, asset, limit. Returns JSON company rows (ticker, CIK, asset, units, filed fair value, cost basis, filing link, live USD value) and per-asset totals.

ticker.description: Optional comma-separated stock tickers. Format: uppercase tickers. Example: MSTR,TSLA. Omit for every company.

asset.description: Optional crypto asset filter. Format: an uppercase ticker. The tool text names BTC, ETH, and SOL. Example: BTC. Omit for every asset.

limit.description: Maximum company rows. Format: positive integer. Example: 50. Omit for the server's current cap.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
